Create, list, read, close, abort, fork and warm sessions.

## List sessions

`GET /v1/sessions` (SDK method `listSessions`)

The sessions the caller may see, newest first, a page at a time.

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `projectId` | string | no |  |
| `scope` | [SessionScope](/api/reference/types/#sessionscope) | no | Where a session works: `project` (in `projectId`) or `organisation`, above every project and in none of them. |
| `agentId` | string | no |  |
| `status` | [SessionStatus](/api/reference/types/#sessionstatus) | no |  |
| `parentSessionId` | string | no |  |
| `workspaceId` | string | no | Sessions running in this workspace: the conversations that share its files, each with its own history. |
| `label` | Record&lt;string, string&gt; | no | Sessions with every one of these labels, each sent as `label.<key>=<value>`, such as `label.ticket=PROJ-12`. |
| `limit` | integer | no |  (minimum 1, maximum 1000) |
| `cursor` | string | no | A previous page's `nextCursor`. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [SessionPage](/api/reference/types/#sessionpage) (`application/json`). A page of sessions.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Create a session

`POST /v1/sessions` (SDK method `createSession`)

Starts a session of an agent profile in a project, and sends it `message` when there is one. Needs the operator role on the project. If the first message is refused, the session is closed and the refusal answered.

**Body**: [CreateSessionBody](/api/reference/types/#createsessionbody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [CreatedSession](/api/reference/types/#createdsession) (`application/json`). The new session.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `422` refused. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get a session

`GET /v1/sessions/{sessionId}` (SDK method `getSession`)

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | string | yes | The session's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [SessionRecord](/api/reference/types/#sessionrecord) (`application/json`). The session.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Close a session

`POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/close` (SDK method `closeSession`)

Ends the session for good: its sandbox leases, browser sessions and grants end. Closing a closed session does nothing.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | string | yes | The session's ID. |

**Answers**

- `204`: no body. Closed.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Abort a session's run

`POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/abort` (SDK method `abortSession`)

Interrupts the session's run in progress, and its child sessions' runs. The conversation keeps its history, and files the run changed stay changed; what the run held ends (its browsers, sandbox leases and grants). The run's result is `aborted`. The session stays open and takes new messages.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | string | yes | The session's ID. |

**Body**: [AbortSessionBody](/api/reference/types/#abortsessionbody)

**Answers**

- `204`: no body. Aborted.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Fork a session from an answer

`POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/fork` (SDK method `forkSession`)

Starts a new session in the same project, with the same agent profile and workspace, whose history is this session's up to and including the answer `itemId` names: a second conversation that carries the first one's context and goes its own way. It starts idle. The source session is unchanged. Needs operator on the project; an item that is not an answer in the session's transcript is `not_found`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | string | yes | The session's ID. |

**Body**: [ForkSessionBody](/api/reference/types/#forksessionbody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [SessionRecord](/api/reference/types/#sessionrecord) (`application/json`). The new session.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `501` not_supported. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Warm a session's sandbox

`POST /v1/sessions/{sessionId}/warm` (SDK method `warmSession`)

A hint that a message is coming, such as when someone starts typing: the session's sandbox gets ready for its next command, so it waits for no start. Its container starts only if the session has used one. Idempotent and cheap to repeat; send it at most every few seconds. Needs the operator role on the session.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sessionId` | string | yes | The session's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [SessionWarmth](/api/reference/types/#sessionwarmth) (`application/json`). What the sandbox did.

**Errors**: `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
